name: Ḥimā Cultural Area
description: Ḥimā Cultural Area sits in the arid mountains of southwest Saudi Arabia, about 120 km north of Najran, beside an ancient caravan route. Its rock faces are covered with carvings of hunters, animals and plants made over 7,000 years, alongside inscriptions in scripts from Musnad to Greek and Arabic. The wells at Bi'r Ḥimā, at least 3,000 years old, still yield fresh water.
